summary: Iteration 75 — Backend fixes all VERIFIED (12/12 pytest pass: 4 new iter75 + 8 iter74 regression). isInvestmentAccount fix is confirmed (no such error on app root). HOWEVER a NEW frontend regression was introduced: ReferenceError 'Cannot access _computeLegacyPerMonthNet before initialization' crashes MainApp on load. Backend: (1) POST /api/user/reset-data returns ok:true with exact deleted_counts {transactions:3, budget_cells:2, notifications:1, import_mappings:1} and PRESERVES linked_accounts, plaid_items, and the user row. (2) DELETE /api/account alias works — user gone, billing_receipts unchanged for a user without stripe_customer_id. (3) DELETE /api/auth/delete-account with pre-seeded stripe_customer_id='cus_test_iter75' + stripe_subscription_id='sub_test_iter75' correctly inserts an anonymised billing_receipts row containing the two Stripe IDs + account_deleted_at, with NO user_id / email / name. (4) Rate limit on /api/user/reset-data is 5/hour and per-IP (slowapi default): within 6 back-to-back calls a 429 is returned monotonically (once 429 starts, no more 200s).

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Cannot access '_computeLegacyPerMonthNet' before initialization. `legacyPerMonthNet` useCallback at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:6363 references `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` in its body AND in its deps array (line 6380), but `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` is declared AFTER it at line 6382. React executes useCallback bodies top-down during render, so the closure captures the identifier in its temporal dead zone. Fix: move the definition of `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` (lines 6382+) ABOVE `legacyPerMonthNet` (line 6363). Crashes the entire app root — the app cannot render past the LogBox error boundary.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix the TDZ ordering bug in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx: move `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` (declared at line 6382) ABOVE `legacyPerMonthNet` (declared at line 6363). The wrapper legacyPerMonthNet uses it inside its try{} body AND as a useCallback dep, so its definition must appear first. This crash was introduced in the same iter75 code drop that added the null-safe isInvestmentAccount guard.

OPTIONAL — the reset-data rate limit uses slowapi's default per-IP key. If per-user semantics are intended (so shared-IP corporate users aren't collectively rate-limited), pass `key_func=lambda r: (r.state.user or {}).get('user_id')` on this route only. Current behavior is still 'safe by default' — just something to consider before broad launch.

rca_of_issue: Frontend TDZ crash RCA: In /app/frontend/app/index.tsx the developer added a defensive wrapper `legacyPerMonthNet` (line 6363) around the original computation, then renamed the original to `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` (line 6382). React's useCallback runs each callback creation eagerly during the MainApp function render, top-to-bottom. When `React.useCallback(..., [_computeLegacyPerMonthNet])` executes at line 6380, the `let`-bound `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet` identifier is still in its Temporal Dead Zone → ReferenceError. Mitigation: move lines 6382→6486 (definition of `_computeLegacyPerMonthNet`) to appear BEFORE line 6363 (definition of `legacyPerMonthNet`). No behavioral change — just declaration order. Reproduction: open the site root in any browser; the Uncaught Error appears immediately after the JS bundle evaluates (screenshot at /app/test_reports/screenshots/iter75_root.jpeg).
